bindings.adapter: async (input, signal) => { const response = await sendChatMessageMutation.mutateAsync({ ...input, onAccepted: () => { if (!signal.aborted) input.onAccepted(); }, }); if (!signal.aborted && response.compiled.position_segments.length) store .getState() .sceneInteractionActions.selectObject({ id: trajectoryObjectId }); return response; }

async (input, signal) => { await clearTrajectoryMutation.mutateAsync(input); if (!signal.aborted) { store.getState().sceneInteractionActions.selectObject({ id: null, ifCurrentId: trajectoryObjectId, }); store.getState().sceneInteractionActions.hoverObject({ id: null, ifCurrentId: trajectoryObjectId, }); store.getState().playbackActions.resetPlayback(); } }

async (input, signal) => { await deleteAnchorMutation.mutateAsync(input); if (!signal.aborted) { const id = anchorObjectId(input); store .getState() .sceneInteractionActions.hoverObject({ id: null, ifCurrentId: id }); store .getState() .sceneInteractionActions.selectObject({ id: null, ifCurrentId: id }); } }
{ canEdit: auth.canEdit, loading: auth.loading, username: auth.username, errorMessage: auth.error?.message ?? null, pending: auth.pending, challenge: auth.challenge, }
(path) => { if (!/^\/(?:projects(?:\/[^/]+)?|library(?:\/[^/]+)?)?$/.test(path)) throw new Error("Unsupported navigation destination"); router.push(path); }

{ webGpuTileRenderer: settings.webGpuTileRenderer, showGrid: settings.showGrid, gaussianDpr: settings.gaussianDpr, loading: settings.loading, saving: settings.saving, ready: settings.ready, errorMessage: settings.error?.message ?? null, }
async (input) => { const response = await projectCloudActionMutation.mutateAsync(input); return { status: response.status }; }

(position) => { const trajectory = compiled.data?.status === 200 ? data.compiledTrajectory.schema.parse(compiled.data.data) : null; const table = trajectory ? createPlaybackTable(trajectory) : []; store .getState() .playbackActions.setPlaybackFrame( position, timeAtPathPosition(table, position), ); }
async (input) => { await updateDefaultCameraOrientationMutation.mutateAsync({ pitch_deg: input.pitch_deg ?? 0, yaw_deg: input.yaw_deg ?? 0, roll_deg: input.roll_deg ?? 0, }); }
